_readme: S721 lever (the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever, run 45371224551): College of the Redwoods' 5 programs whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses. Automotive Technology A.S. 01816 and Advanced Automotive Technology certificate 22666 were handed each other's page; Aquaculture Technology A.S. 42928 the certificate page (aquaculture-technology-ca-fall-2023); Early Childhood Education certificate 13559 the page early-childhood-education-fall-2018; North Coast Paramedic certificate 30811 its own-looking page, whose record placed none of HO159, HO170A, HO170B and HO170D. This plan reads each candidate page through the publish/content call the capture reads, and the menu's publish call for the Early Childhood and Paramedic addresses, so a session checks each site_pages pin against the text the capture will read. No model call, nothing written.

questions.own_page: What the capture reads on each program's own page: its heading, its course list and its total.
questions.menu: Which addresses the menu gives Early Childhood Education and Paramedic programs.
